relations.name: effective_stay_assignments
relations.definition:
SELECT s.id,
    s.organization_id,
    s.booking_id,
    s.resident_id,
    s.bed_id,
    s.kind,
    s.status,
        CASE
            WHEN ((r.segment ->> 'replaceStart'::text))::boolean THEN ((r.segment ->> 'startAt'::text))::timestamp with time zone
            ELSE s.start_at
        END AS start_at,
        CASE
            WHEN ((r.segment ->> 'replaceEnd'::text))::boolean THEN ((r.segment ->> 'endAt'::text))::timestamp with time zone
            ELSE s.end_at
        END AS end_at,
    s.transfer_id,
    s.created_at,
    r.id AS replacement_id
   FROM (stay_assignments s
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT h.id,
            e.segment
           FROM (stay_assignment_replacements h
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(h.segments) e(segment))
          WHERE ((h.organization_id = s.organization_id) AND (h.booking_id = s.booking_id) AND ((e.segment ->> 'id'::text) = (s.id)::text))
          ORDER BY h.version DESC
         LIMIT 1) r ON (true));

CASE

    ELSE 0
END +

    WHEN (booking_target_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0

functions.body:
BEGIN
    -- Prevent updates to terminal proposals
    IF OLD."status" <> 'PENDING' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'terminal proposals cannot change' USING ERRCODE = '23001';
    END IF;
    -- Prevent changes to immutable fields even in PENDING
    IF OLD."id" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."id" OR
       OLD."organization_id" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."organization_id" OR
       OLD."target_type" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."target_type" OR
       OLD."field_key" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."field_key" OR
       OLD."original_value" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."original_value" OR
       OLD."proposed_value" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."proposed_value" OR
       OLD."expected_snapshot" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."expected_snapshot" OR
       OLD."reason" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."reason" OR
       OLD."evidence_reference" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."evidence_reference" OR
       OLD."effective_at" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."effective_at" OR
       OLD."recorded_at" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."recorded_at" OR
       OLD."requested_by" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."requested_by" OR
       OLD."requested_role" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."requested_role" OR
       OLD."financial_impact" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."financial_impact" OR
       OLD."correlation_id" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."correlation_id" OR
       OLD."related_proposal_id" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."related_proposal_id" OR
       OLD."relation_kind" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."relation_kind"
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable fields cannot change' USING ERRCODE = '23001';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;

BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM transfer_finance_reviews r WHERE r.id=NEW.review_id AND r.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND r.requested_by_user_id=NEW.actor_user_id)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id JOIN organizations o ON o.id=m.organization_id
 WHERE m.user_id=NEW.actor_user_id AND m.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND m.role='OWNER' AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND o.status='ACTIVE') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'independent active owner required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END
